Finite checker numbers only corroborate formulas and are not used as proofs.

value.rationale: The natural maximally symmetric four-center example within the 2023 classified cubic Kolmogorov Hamiltonians has previously discussed center configurations but not a global period-energy shape. Strict complete monotonicity controls every derivative on each full annulus, is stronger than textbook first-derivative monotonicity/absence of critical periods, and supplies exact original-time separatrix scaling and center normalization. The axis-aligned anisotropic family is the complete diagonal-rescaling orbit of this canonical model, not an arbitrarily chosen finite calculation or a new theorem merely by renaming.
